body.statement: For every \(\delta\in[0,1]\), the construction in \(\text{def:k2-worked-lift}\) satisfies \(x_\star^{(2)}\in\mathcal P_\delta(b^{(2)},q^{(2)},\omega_\star^{(2)})\) and its displayed full law belongs to \(\mathfrak M_\delta(b^{(2)},q^{(2)},\omega_\star^{(2)})\). It yields the displayed nonzero trial risks, uniform exposure margins, \(\rho_{t0}(x_\star^{(2)},\omega_\star^{(2)})=\rho_{t1}(x_\star^{(2)},\omega_\star^{(2)})=1/2\) for \(t=1,2\), and \(\Psi_{\omega_\star^{(2)}}(x_\star^{(2)})=\{1\}\).
body.justification: The numerical lift exposes every step from one common exposure history through observed strain risks to a compatible full law.
body.gap: This is a worked certificate for the new multi-variant compression, not a standalone novelty claim.
body.consumer: Readers and software implementers obtain a four-atom regression test for feasibility, lifting, and ratio evaluation.
